the Wadden Sea acts as a sink for suspended particulate matter.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the interaction between horizontal density gradients and tidal currents is an important mechanism for the accumulation of suspended matter in coastal seas.

horizontal density gradients can have a significant effect on the transport of SPM into the Wadden sea, and that this effect is not only important during the spring tide, but also during the neap tide.
